subject: Whoa J&As — Oct 20: ICE definitizes Camp East Montana letter contract with Amentum at about $2.8 billion
body:
## 1. ICE definitizes Camp East Montana letter contract with Amentum at about $2.8 billion

**US IMMIGRATION AND CUSTOMS ENFORCEMENT (HOMELAND SECURITY, DEPARTMENT OF) · Amentum Services Inc. · $2,796,540,325.26 · RFO 6.103-1**  
*Posted 2026-10-19, award 70CDCR26C00000016, “Camp East Montana”*

The revised J&A definitizes a sole-source letter contract with Amentum and says the estimated total value has increased because of a longer period of performance. It states Amentum is the only responsible source because of its ownership and operational control of the facility infrastructure.

> “The definitized action reflects an increased period of performance and increased estimated cost from the original letter contract planning assumptions.”  
> — Other Than Full and Open Competition Redacted for Public Release_10.19.26.pdf, p. 1

> “Total | | | $2,796,540,325.26 Note: The total estimated value is based on the Government's current pricing assumptions and the independent government cost estimate supporting definitization.”  
> — Other Than Full and Open Competition Redacted for Public Release_10.19.26.pdf, p. 2 (machine-transcribed page) (source of the figure above, quoted by the checks)

[SAM.gov notice](https://sam.gov/opp/53d80bf144804de8a5e5138dd62cf873/view) · [Other Than Full and Open Competition Redacted for Public Release_10.19.26.pdf](https://huggingface.co/datasets/abigailhaddad/federal-ja-documents/resolve/e93882dcc18c1d76244974093b3696fd5e5e016e/files/53d80bf144804de8a5e5138dd62cf873/d542b26604ce40a598782fbee8c9a018_Other_Than_Full_and_Open_Competition_Redacted_for_Public_Release_10.19.26.pdf) · [Other_Than_Full_and_Open_Competition_Redacted for Public Release.pdf](https://huggingface.co/datasets/abigailhaddad/federal-ja-documents/resolve/e93882dcc18c1d76244974093b3696fd5e5e016e/files/53d80bf144804de8a5e5138dd62cf873/d83bcd08bad544b3aa3b1c22a208bcc9_Other_Than_Full_and_Open_Competition_Redacted_for_Public_Release.pdf)

## 2. VA extends CCN Region 3 community care contract a year amid protests

**VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF · RFO 6.103-2**  
*Posted 2026-10-19, award 36C79119D0006, “Q201--CCN R3 Contract Extension”*

VA is using unusual and compelling urgency to extend CCN Region 3 for up to one year, through September 30, 2027. It cites two protests, more than 1,600 industry questions and potential litigation risk as pushing back the follow-on award.

> “The scope and complexity of the procurement, combined with two protests, more than 1,600 industry questions, and potential future litigation risks, continue to push key milestones to the right.”  
> — Attachment 1 - Justification  Approval Redacted R3.pdf, p. 3

[SAM.gov notice](https://sam.gov/opp/c4bad86f34314b579a52144c1c0d2fa0/view) · [Attachment 1 - Justification  Approval Redacted R3.pdf](https://huggingface.co/datasets/abigailhaddad/federal-ja-documents/resolve/e93882dcc18c1d76244974093b3696fd5e5e016e/files/c4bad86f34314b579a52144c1c0d2fa0/fa1e4af44f4444d587726fbde019bcf6_Attachment_1_-_Justification_Approval_Redacted_R3.pdf) · [36C79119D0006 P00152_2.docx](https://huggingface.co/datasets/abigailhaddad/federal-ja-documents/resolve/e93882dcc18c1d76244974093b3696fd5e5e016e/files/c4bad86f34314b579a52144c1c0d2fa0/2930175d7b6449359032dd679845b053_36C79119D0006_P00152_2.docx)

## 3. Marine Corps sole-sources Mi-24 HIND adversary air after protest stalls award

**DEPT OF THE NAVY (DEPT OF DEFENSE) · VTS Aviation LLC · $527,834.44 · 10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(2)**  
*Posted 2026-10-19, award M0068126P0076, “WTI 1-27 Sole Source J&A”*

A GAO protest stayed a competitive award, and the Government took voluntary corrective action. It then sole-sourced a roughly four-week urgent buy of adversary helicopter and drone threat replication for the WTI 1-27 course.

> “The stay occurred 49 days prior to the live-flight phase, creating an unexpected, immediate gap in cont racted threat repli cation”  
> — MCIWEST WTI-1-27 JA signed (1).pdf, p. 2

> “The estimated dollar value of the contract is $527,834.44, funded using FY26 Operations and Maintenance, Marine Corps (O&M, MC) appropriations. 4.”  
> — MCIWEST WTI-1-27 JA signed (1).pdf, p. 1 (source of the figure above, quoted by the checks)

[SAM.gov notice](https://sam.gov/opp/077d851fe0a7404abb51862ff565859f/view) · [MCIWEST WTI-1-27 JA signed (1).pdf](https://huggingface.co/datasets/abigailhaddad/federal-ja-documents/resolve/e93882dcc18c1d76244974093b3696fd5e5e016e/files/077d851fe0a7404abb51862ff565859f/9909d154bbac44c88e43017196bb3d08_MCIWEST_WTI-1-27_JA_signed_1_.pdf)
